name: Kaguya-hime
source:
That day, as usual, the bamboo cutter went to the mountains to gather bamboo. It was supposed to be just another day of bamboo cutting, but something was amiss. The forest was strangely bright.
"What is this...?"
Inside a bamboo stalk whose base was glowing, there was a cute baby. The old man picked up the baby and headed home. But the strange events didn't end there. Every time he went to cut bamboo, gold would come out of the bamboo he had cut.
In the old man's mansion, now quite wealthy, Kaguya was dressed in beautiful kimonos and came to be known as "Princess Kaguya of the Bamboo Cutter's Palace." Her beauty was beyond description, and as word of her spread, so many men came vying to marry her when she came of age.

Then one day, the old man witnessed a strange sight. On a full moon night, Princess Kaguya stood on the veranda of the mansion, completely naked.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/198201/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
那一天，竹取翁也一如往常上山砍竹子。原本应该只是平平常常的砍竹之日，情况却有些不对劲——竹林里出奇地明亮。
“这是什么……”
在一根根部发光的竹子里，有一个可爱的婴儿。老翁抱起婴儿踏上了归途。然而不可思议的事并未就此结束，每当他去砍竹子，砍开的竹子里都会涌出黄金。
老翁彻底富裕起来后，在他的宅邸里，辉夜身穿华美的和服，开始被人称作“竹取御殿的辉夜姬”。她的美貌难以言喻，随着传闻传开，到了适婚年龄时，想要迎娶辉夜姬的人更是络绎不绝。

直到某一天，老翁目睹了奇异的一幕。在满月之夜，辉夜姬一丝不挂地站在宅邸的缘侧上。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/198201/]Getchu[/url]]
